meta.name: add-opencode
meta.description: Use OpenCode as an agent provider. OpenRouter, OpenAI, Google, DeepSeek, etc. via OpenCode config — not the Anthropic Agent SDK. Per group via `ncl groups config update --provider opencode`; host passes OPENCODE_* and XDG mount when spawning containers.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让编码智能体通过 OpenCode 调用不同大模型。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在搭建编码智能体,并希望它们通过 OpenCode 使用多家模型。
copy.tagline_en: Make your coding agents call multiple LLMs through OpenCode.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are building coding agents and want them to use multiple LLMs through OpenCode.

howto.what: 装上后，系统在默认的 Claude 之外会多出一个 OpenCode 后端，可改用 DeepSeek、OpenRouter 等模型跑智能体。安装过程会复制 OpenCode 相关文件、注册组件、安装依赖并重建镜像。
howto.when: 当你想让系统通过 OpenCode 连接 DeepSeek、OpenRouter 等外部模型，代替内置的 Claude 后端时触发。也可以用于把 OpenCode 组件补进已有项目。

say.text: 给这个项目安装 OpenCode 后端。
say.note: 会复制文件、装依赖并重建镜像。

say.text: 改用 DeepSeek 作为模型后端。
帮我配置 OpenRouter 并切换过去。
say.note: 会走 OpenCode 配置并设置密钥访问。

howto.what_en: After setup, the agent backend gains an OpenCode provider alongside the default Claude. The skill copies OpenCode source files from the providers branch, registers imports, installs dependencies, and rebuilds the image.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want the system to use external models such as DeepSeek or OpenRouter through OpenCode instead of the built-in Claude backend, or to add the OpenCode components to an existing project.

say_en.text: Set up the OpenCode backend for this project.
say_en.note: It copies files, installs deps, and rebuilds the image.

say_en.text: Switch the model backend to DeepSeek.
say_en.note: After install, set OPENCODE_MODEL etc. in .env.

say_en.text: Configure OpenRouter and switch to it.
say_en.note: Uses OpenCode config and grants key access.
